zh: 他讲完那个笑话后，出现了一阵尴尬的沉默。
en: There was an {awkward|uncomfortable} silence after his joke.

zh: 他很大方，总是请大家喝酒。
en: He's very {generous}; he always pays for everyone's drinks.

zh: 她跟不认识的人在一起有点害羞。
en: She's a bit {shy} with new people.

zh: 他非常外向，在聚会上跟谁都聊。
en: He's really {outgoing|sociable|extroverted}; he talks to everyone at parties.

zh: 别人说话的时候看手机是不礼貌的。
en: It's {rude|impolite} to look at your phone while someone is talking.

zh: 孩子们很有礼貌，对每个人都说了谢谢。
en: The kids were very {polite}; they said thank you to everyone.

zh: 我忘了她的名字，当时特别难为情。
en: I was so {embarrassed} when I forgot her name.

zh: 我的室友非常随和，什么都好商量。
en: My flatmate is really {easy-going|easygoing|relaxed|laid-back}; nothing bothers him.

zh: 我真的很感激你所有的帮助。
en: I'm really {grateful|thankful} for all your help.

zh: 说实话，我不喜欢那部电影。
en: To be {honest|frank}, I didn't enjoy the film.

zh: 他女朋友跟别的男生说话，他就会吃醋。
en: He gets {jealous} when his girlfriend talks to other guys.

zh: 我们从小学起就是很亲密的朋友。
en: We've been {close|good} friends since primary school.

zh: 我的邻居特别爱打听，总问我要去哪儿。
en: My neighbour is so {nosy|nosey}; she always asks where I'm going.

zh: 别拿他的体重开玩笑，他对这个很敏感。
en: Don't joke about his weight; he's very {sensitive|touchy} about it.

zh: 你还带了花来，真是太体贴了。
en: It was very {thoughtful|considerate|kind|sweet|nice} of you to bring flowers.

zh: 聚会上我一个人都不认识，所以觉得很无聊。
en: I was {bored} at the party because I didn't know anyone.

zh: 我们是通过一个共同的朋友认识的。
en: We met through a {mutual} friend.

zh: 她话特别多，你根本插不上嘴。
en: She's very {talkative|chatty}; you can't get a word in.

zh: 我丢了工作的时候，朋友们都很支持我。
en: My friends were really {supportive} when I lost my job.

zh: 你哥哥还是单身吗？
en: Is your brother still {single}?
